name: io.github.softbot-studio/softbot-mcp
title: Softbot Studio agent tools
description: Pay-per-call x402 tools (USDC on Solana): read pages, extract data, token/wallet/email/website checks, screenshots, PDFs.

environmentVariables.name: SOLANA_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Solana keypair (base58 or JSON byte array) of a wallet holding USDC; pays each call

environmentVariables.name: SOFTBOT_DRY_RUN
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to only show prices, never pay
